newsSince: Hesai Q1 2026 revenue grew 29.6% YoY to RMB 681M with 471,723 LiDAR shipments, GAAP profitability, and Q2 guidance of RMB 850M-900M. Management highlighted #1 positioning in humanoid/quadruped robot LiDAR, JT128 powering Honor's Lightning robot, and 2026 shipment guidance of 3.0M-3.5M units.

verdicts.rankRationale: Hesai is less hidden than the best microcaps, but Q1 profitability, 3.0M-3.5M annual shipment guide, and explicit humanoid/quadruped leadership strengthen the physical-AI sensor case.
verdicts.bull: Concrete robotics design wins (Zelos 200k, NIU, KargoBot) + Kosmo/SGI give real physical-AI optionality; GAAP profitable.
verdicts.neutral: Strong execution but robotics revenue still small vs ADAS core.
verdicts.bear: -33% YTD; US listing/geopolitical overhang; SGI revenue immaterial near-term.
verdicts.primaryCatalyst: Kosmo demo shipments + robotics design-win ramp H2 2026
verdicts.primaryRisk: China-ADR policy risk; robotics monetization slower than guided
